# compute_psds_pocketwise_accessible { #mofography.rust_fun.compute_psds_pocketwise_accessible }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-alternate">alternate</span> Pocket-wise PSD restricted to winding-percolating regions at a probe radius.

```python
rust_fun.compute_psds_pocketwise_accessible(
    results,
    mat_atoms,
    probe_radius,
    num_samples_per_region=1000,
    bins=None,
    return_fig=False,
    material='Material',
    probe_center_min_radius=None,
    enforce_probe_center_occupiable=False,
)
```

Compute pocket-wise PSD restricted to accessible (percolating) regions only.

Returns the same dict structure as compute_psds_pocketwise_rust for app compatibility:
{region_id: {'hist', 'bin_centers', 'num_samples', 'mean_pore_size', 'std_pore_size'}}

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name                   | Type                  | Description                                                                    | Default      |
|------------------------|-----------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------|
| results                | dict                  | Segmentation results from do_periodic_segmentation_rust with return_dgrid=True | _required_   |
| mat_atoms              | ase.Atoms             | ASE Atoms with the simulation cell                                             | _required_   |
| probe_radius           | float                 | Probe radius (Å) for percolation threshold                                     | _required_   |
| num_samples_per_region | int                   | Samples per pocket                                                             | `1000`       |
| bins                   | numpy.ndarray \| None | Bin edges for histogram. If None, uses np.linspace(0, 50, 200)                 | `None`       |
| return_fig             | bool                  | Whether to return a plotly figure                                              | `False`      |
| material               | str                   | Name of the material for plot title                                            | `'Material'` |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                               | Description                                                                    |
|--------|----------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | dict \| tuple\[dict, plotly.graph_objects.Figure\] | pocket_psds or (pocket_psds, fig) - same shape as compute_psds_pocketwise_rust |
